sources.title: How to use model router for Microsoft Foundry - Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Model router is a trained language model that selects the best large language model (LLM) to respond to a prompt in real time. It uses different preexisting models to deliver high performance and save on compute costs, all in one model deployment.
